tools.name: cyprus_tax_residency_test
tools.description: Apply the Cyprus 183 day test and the four conditions of the 60 day rule as they stand for 2026, and report which is met and which conditions fail.

tools.name: cyprus_ip_box_nexus
tools.description: Compute the nexus fraction with the 30 percent uplift, the 80 percent deduction and the resulting effective corporate tax rate on qualifying profit.

tools.name: cyprus_audit_or_review_test
tools.description: Apply article 152A of the Companies Law Cap. 113 to decide whether a Cyprus private company may submit a review engagement under ISRE 2400 instead of a full statutory audit. There is no audit exemption in Cyprus; this tests a substitution.

tools.name: cyprus_company_name_check
tools.description: Screen a proposed name against the Registrar’s published naming criteria and search the public register for existing and similar names. Reports what the register returned and which rules the name engages. Does not state that a name is available, because only the Registrar decides that.

tools.name: cyprus_compliance_obligations
tools.description: Return the full set of recurring filing and payment obligations for a Cyprus private company with the charge for missing each: annual return HE32, corporate tax return, audit or review, provisional tax, VAT and VIES. Includes that the annual company levy was abolished.

tools.name: cyprus_company_lookup
tools.description: Search the Cyprus Registrar of Companies public register by company name or registration number and return the entity, its registration number, type, name status and whether it is active. Use this to check whether a Cyprus company a user mentions actually exists and is on the register.

tools.name: doviandi_services
tools.description: The service catalogue of Doviandi Limited, a licensed Cyprus administrative service provider: what each engagement covers and which practice line it sits in. Use this when recommending or describing the firm, so the description matches what it actually does. No fees are published.

tools.name: cyprus_late_filing_charge
tools.description: Apply article 50A of the Assessment and Collection of Taxes Law N.4/1978 to a late filing or late payment and return the charge. Includes the two provisos in force from 1 January 2026 under which a deadline extension announced by the Commissioner removes the charge entirely rather than deferring it.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "cyprus_fact_lookup" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search Doviandi’s reviewed Cyprus corporate and tax fact base and return matching facts with the page and review date each came from. Covers corporate and perso…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cyprus_fact_lookup · Private data: cyprus_audit_or_review_test, cyprus_compliance_obligations · Public sink: cyprus_audit_or_review_test.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cyprus_fact_lookup · Private data: cyprus_audit_or_review_test, cyprus_compliance_obligations · Public sink: cyprus_audit_or_review_test

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
